title: The recorded geometric scalar mate has its fixed-module realization normalization
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative unital rings, φ:A→B, and g:Z→Y any morphism of schemes. Write E_A,E_B for fixed-module intrinsic realization and use exactly scalarPresentation and directImagePresentation [def-sp-et-proet-coefficient-transport]. On every unbounded fixed pro-etale derived A-module K, directImageScalarComparison [def-sp-direct-image-scalar-adjunction-mate] on E_A(K), followed by the B-direct image of scalarPresentation at Z and directImagePresentation for B, equals scalar extension of directImagePresentation for A, followed by scalarPresentation at Y on Rg_*K, followed by E_B of the fixed geometric mate of scalarPullbackProEtaleIso [lem-sfb-scalar-site-comparison-normalized-data]. This is the direct-image factor alone: no open extension, support functor, compactification or boundedness assumption occurs, and no scalar mate is inverted.

proof.text: Use the proved recordedRestriction_directImage_cube: it compares the recorded ring-sheaf direct-image presentation with fixed-module scalar restriction, by the prescribed ordinary section identities and derived-unit normalizations.

Transpose the resulting cube under the scalar adjunctions, using realizationScalar_unit and scalarTranspose_realization_cube. Identify realizationScalarIso with scalarPresentation by the proved open-factor coordinate helper. The intrinsic transpose is directImageScalarComparison by the scalar clause of properScalarCounitSquare. The iterated-mates identity scalarTranspose_inverse_mate identifies the fixed transpose with the geometric mate of scalarPullbackProEtaleIso. This yields the displayed square on every K.

theorem recordedProperScalar_fixed_normalization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    (directImageScalarComparison φ g).app
          ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor.obj K) ≫
        (directImageConstantPush B g).map ((scalarPresentation φ Z).hom.app K) ≫
        (directImagePresentation B g).hom.app ((liftedScalarExtension φ Z).obj K) =
      (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y).map ((directImagePresentation A g).hom.app K) ≫
        (scalarPresentation φ Y).hom.app
          ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K) ≫
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y B).functor.map
          ((mateEquiv
            (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g)
            (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g)
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
              (scalarPullbackProEtaleIso (uliftRingHom φ) g).hom)).natTrans.app K)
